title: AStages Pufferfish's Skills
description: Adds a bridge between AStages and Pufferfish's Skills.
body:
## AStages-Pufferfish's Skills Bridge

This lightweight mod adds a simple integration between **[AStages](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/astages)** and **[Pufferfish's Skills](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/pufferfishs-skills)**.  
It allows skills in the skill tree to **grant or remove AStages** when unlocked by the player.

### Features

*   Assign one stage when a skill is unlocked.
*   Simple datapack-based configuration.
*   Useful for RPG and stage-driven progression systems.

> Requires both AStages and Pufferfish's Skills to be installed.

### Customization

Stages can be granted or removed by adding a simple `astages` section to your skill JSON.  
See the **Wiki** for syntax and examples.
